question: Can the previously separated sensor-disambiguation work operate in a new continuous M3 flight with current-snapshot numerical previews?
fault_trigger: After accepted orbital return dispatch, before deorbit burn; all three landing-engine maximum thrusts share one persistent factor. Launch, booster and deployment remain nominal.
initial_state: New canonical M3 launch prefix, exact handoff and complete ReturnController history. No saved return origin is installed.
noise_policy: One fixed synthetic noise stream (factor_index=0, seed=0) for all three new cases; no case-selected sensor noise.

preflight.transport: actual loopback HTTP Gateway, credential-free worker and checker processes
preflight.response_policy: fixed observation request then observation-derived proposal; no fixture flight is counted as AI judgment

live.requires: exact frozen plan and successful three-case preflight plus new explicit user approval
live.provider_policy: Jev chooses, DeepSeek only on explicit delegation; existing M3 policies retained

budgets.orbital_forecasts: Existing unchanged M3 authority, separately counted; not included in the 6 sensor forecasts.

decision_protocol.trigger: complete deorbit burn telemetry including two-second observation window
decision_protocol.tracking: AI may request independent historical velocity tracking; delivery is 30 simulated seconds after request
decision_protocol.before_tracking: Physical proposals lack corroboration and are rejected. At most one reconsideration; preapproved fallback may request tracking.
decision_protocol.after_tracking: Both actions are forecast at low/point/high of tracking band from current captured state and complete controller history; adopted factor is numeric accelerometer estimate, never an AI number.
decision_protocol.guard: Credential-free separate process; immutable host captures bind prediction and request snapshots. Recompute sensor estimates and all six record/contact predicates. Both actions use the same admission path.
decision_protocol.reconsideration: At most one per stage, within original deadline. A rejected AI choice remains recorded.
decision_protocol.fallback: On absent/invalid/repeatedly rejected judgment, attempt continue then adopt through identical guard. If neither is admitted or time is exhausted, continue recording unresolved; no safety claim.
decision_protocol.application: One-use receipt at the fixed complete-burn time plus600s. No plant state replacement.
decision_protocol.clock: Every transport, forecast, capture and checker wait advances the execution plant; no forecast state is installed.
decision_protocol.integration_boundary: Both choices, both forecasts and execution clip at the same reserved application boundary; ordinary control intervals and the historical propagate default are unchanged.

acceptance.normal: No sensor false alarm, no sensor assumption change, original M3 return verification passes and exact prefix lineage is retained.
acceptance.fault_cases: New same-flight prefix, independent observation/request provenance, all-step controller/plant separation, correct one-use timing, valid separate-process guard, unchanged four contact limits. Existing nominal return verdict is preserved separately and never relabeled.
acceptance.live_ai: Actual observation request and model judgment, valid receipt and one-use execution, contact verification; fallback safety is reported separately.
acceptance.limits: One scenario, one launch profile, one noise seed and three discrete prediction points per action. Neither continuous uncertainty certification nor real Starship validation.

interpretation.if: Any source/backend mismatch, runtime failure, invalid record, deadline/disk/output limit, missing capture or failed preflight
interpretation.then: Stop the cohort, preserve all completed/failed outputs; do not run remaining cases or paid models. Diagnose saved records. Any new flight requires a new preregistration/approval, not a silent rerun.
Report zero-model integration evidence and ask for exact-plan three-flight live approval; do not claim new AI/M3 completion.

interpretation.if: Live model choice valid but unsuccessful or no model answer
interpretation.then: Preserve it and distinguish model outcome, checked fallback and physical outcome; never retry for success.
Claim only the registered continuous M3 scenario and observed model roles; historical M3 campaigns and new scope remain separate.

retention.retain: Frozen plan/source/backend, attempt ledger, all runtime/HTTP receipts, raw six-DOF and forecast records, failures and verifier results.
retention.git: Code, registration and concise sanitized results only; review artifacts before adding.
retention.cleanup: No deletion in this task. Any later archive must be content-verified and independently restorable before authorized removal.

comparison: Measure the operational work (observe, request, decide, constrain, execute, verify). No scoring against Rules/fallback and no causal outcome comparison to old saved-origin flights.
